ask_the_client_note: Every row is on the return. A ticked row is asked for and reminded; an unticked one is never asked for, but a document that arrives for it is filed there.

editor.paste_hint: Paste rows copied from a spreadsheet: one request per line, cells separated by tabs or as CSV, in the column order above; a first line that repeats the headings is skipped. Nothing is recorded until you save.
editor.rename_hint: Gives a request another identifier and moves its filed documents with it, at once. Changing an identifier in the list and saving is refused while the request holds documents; a change of case alone is saved in the list.
editor.routing_help: How the tracker recognises this document when it arrives. A save checks these the same way whether the fold is open or not.
editor.title: Request List
editor.unlearned_note: {keyword} unlearned from {identifier}; the request was re-scanned

extension_default_note: blank means pdf, xlsx, csv; a photo or an image counts as a PDF

household.accept_folder_name_help: records that this household (or this return) is now called by its folder's name; nothing is moved or renamed
household.contact_help: the greeting name in every return's letter, filled into each return when it is made
household.feeds_help: returns in other households this drop folder feeds, by return line; most households feed only their own
household.form_step_note: The request list is tailored to the form you pick.
household.heading: Household
household.link_help: pasted into every return's letter; paste it once the inbox is shared
household.members_help: who this household's folder is meant to be shared with - the tracker cannot read Drive's sharing, so this is the firm's own note
household.misfits_note: Each is listed with the one reason it does not fit the layout; nothing in it is ever read, moved or renamed.
household.new_intro: A client folder is a household: one folder per tax year inside it, one folder per return inside that, and one inbox the client drops everything into.
household.queue_line: {n} document(s) waiting for a person across this household
household.return_created: Return "{label}" created with {n} request(s) asked for, client README generated. Open the Client Folder to show it.
household.return_name_help: the return's folder name, form first; the same name every year
household.roll_intro: Last year's list is the starting point. Everything the client actually sent, set aside or under-delivered carries forward - what was set aside as not applicable under its own heading, for a fresh decision; the form template only fills blanks.
household.sharing_heading: Before the client can drop anything
household.sharing_note: The tracker cannot see Drive's sharing. The two grants are the firm's to make, once; the year folders are view-only through the household folder, and nothing is ever re-shared.

Accepted.label: Accepted
Accepted.sentence: A person accepted it with a reason; the rules stop here.

Failed Validation.label: Could Not Use
Failed Validation.sentence: Something arrived that the rules could not use.

Missing.label: Outstanding
Missing.sentence: Asked for; nothing usable has arrived yet.

Not Applicable.label: Not Applicable in TY{year}
Not Applicable.sentence: Does not apply this year; not counted, not chased.

Not asked.label: Not Asked
Not asked.sentence: On the list, not requested; filed if it arrives.

Partial.label: Partly In
Partial.sentence: Some of the expected files are in; the rest are still to come.

Pending Sync.label: Syncing
Pending Sync.sentence: It is in; the cloud is still copying it down.

Received.label: Received
Received.sentence: In, and every check passed or a person accepted it.

Requested.label: Not Yet Checked
Requested.sentence: Asked for; no pass has looked at it yet.

lock.buttons_back: The pass let go of this return; its buttons are back.
lock.cleared: The lock left behind was cleared ({minutes} min old).
lock.greyed: This return's buttons are greyed while it runs and come back by themselves the moment it lets go.

override_reasons: Client confirmed this is the final version

sides.sentence: The letter asks the client for it.

reminder.stage_toggle_hint: the pass pre-selects the stage from the Due Date; move it up or down before you send

review_labels.issuer_help: Adds {identifier}, a K-1 row for this issuer, to the request list and files this document under it. Type the distinctive words and leave off the suffix (L.P., LLC).
review_labels.keyword_help: A word this document contains that others like it will too. Taught to the request so the next one files itself; the editor shows it beside the row.
review_labels.moved_summary: these working copies are not where the record put them; choose for each - nothing is guessed

rules.detail: Every routing and status decision comes from deterministic rules in the manifest.
rules.headline: No generative AI ever reads a client financial document.

rules.detail: Files are moved byte for byte under their own names out of Drop files here into the client's folder for the year; all work happens on copies, and every move is recorded in the record.
rules.headline: Originals are never altered.

rules.detail: A document is filed only when exactly one request accepts it - or, when one document names several forms as itself, when each of those forms is accepted by exactly one request, or, when a broker's consolidated statement is accepted by several requests, when exactly one of them accepts it for its 1099-B, which then holds the whole statement. Ambiguous, contested and unrecognized files go to 00 - Needs Review for a person - misfiling a tax document is worse than not filing it.
rules.headline: Nothing is guessed.

rules.detail: The system drafts client emails and stops. There is no SMTP, no mail client and no network call in the reminder or scheduling path.
rules.headline: Nothing is ever sent.

scan.not_in_pass: The pass ended, but its final line does not name this return, so its counts are not shown; the page is drawn from the record.

schedule.note: Scan works either way. Nothing is ever sent.
schedule.repair_help: Register the daily job again on this computer - only needed if the schedule was deleted or broken
schedule.title: Schedule on This Computer

settings.firm_help: as it should sign the reminders
settings.phone_help: named in the final-notice reminder; blank drops that sentence

year_note: Defaults to the most recently ended year; the checklist's periods follow it
